assertions.source: bringColorTube(q_0) ≈ 2.460, bringColorTube(q_0^-1) ≈ 0.931 → |diff| ≈ 1.529 ≫ 1e-30 threshold. The q^{10} factor breaks the bar-involution invariance.

assertions.name: family_a_is_bar_symmetric
assertions.source: Family A = (3q² + 4 + 3q⁻²)/4 is manifestly invariant under q ↔ q⁻¹ (q² + q⁻² is even).

description: Bar-symmetry (q ↔ q⁻¹) test for three candidate linking_weight forms in VolDensity(𝓑₃). Family A and via-Jones are bar-symmetric; Bring color-tube and the combined Bring + compact-q-dilog h⁴ are bar-asymmetric (Φ_q-side mass-anchor convention, per the cheat sheet §4). The +108 ppm m_p match of the Bring + compact-q-dilog h⁴ candidate relies on the q^{10} asymmetry — symmetrising loses the numerical match. This is an additional axis of categorical distinctness between the three candidates.

data.interpretation: Three candidates split into TWO bar-symmetry classes: (1) Family A and via-Jones are bar-symmetric (linking_weight respects q ↔ q⁻¹ involution); (2) Bring color-tube and the combined Bring + compact-q-dilog h⁴ are bar-asymmetric (Φ_q-side, per the cheat sheet §4 convention sorting). The asymmetry is framework-consistent for mass-anchor compute (37 scripts use Φ_q), but introduces NEW asymmetry that neither Family A nor via-Jones have — an additional axis of categorical distinctness.
